He also represents the [[Serbia national basketball team|Serbian national basketball team]]. Standing at {{height|m=1.98}}, he plays at the [[shooting guard]] position. ==Professional career== ===Early years=== Bogdanović started his career in Belgrade based clubs, KK Zvezdara and KK Žitko Basket. Later on, he had played for [[KK FMP|FMP]] junior team. Bogdanović took a part in the [[Euroleague Basketball Nike International Junior Tournament]] in 2010.{{cite web|title=Nike Invitational Junior Tournament pits defending champs FMP against hometown INSEP|url=http://www.ballineurope.com/european-basketball/euroleague/nike-invitational-junior-tournament-pits-defending-champs-fmp-belgrad-vs-insep-6297/|work=ballineurope.com|accessdate=24 April 2014}} ===Partizan Belgrade=== In September 2010, Bogdanović had signed his first professional contract with [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]].{{cite news | url=http://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2010&mm=09&dd=17&nav_id=459524 | title=Bogdan Bogdanović u Partizanu | publisher=b92.net| date=September 17, 2010 | accessdate=October 6, 2013}}{{sr icon}} In his first [[2012-13 Euroleague|Euroleague]] season with the team, he averaged 5 points and 1.8 rebounds over 6 games. After being invited to play for the national team in the summer of 2013, he saw increased trust of coach [[Duško Vujošević]], which reflected on his minutes in 2013-14 season and bigger role in the team. In the Euroleague game victory over [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]] in Belgrade, Bogdanović scored career-high 27 points, shooting 10 from 16 from the field.{{cite web|title=Partizan NIS Belgrade vs. CSKA Moscow Boxscore|url=http://www.euroleague.net/main/results/showgame?gamenumber=13&phasetypecode=TS%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20&gamecode=143&seasoncode=E2013#!boxscore|work=euroleague.net|accessdate=14 March 2014}} Shortly after the game, he was praised by national team selector [[Aleksandar Đorđević]] as being one of the most promising European players.{{cite web|last=Velimirović|first=I.|title=Bogdanovićev prvi trener za Blicsport: Bogdan ima Đorđevićev šmek za igru|url=http://sport.blic.rs/Kosarka/Domaca-kosarka-i-ABA/246627/Bogdanovicev-prvi-trener-za-Blicsport-Bogdan-ima-Djordjevicev-smek-za-igru|work=sport.blic.rs|accessdate=14 March 2014}}{{sr icon}} In a February ABA League away game versus [[KK Cibona|Cibona]], Bogdanović scored career-high 32 points, also adding 4 rebounds and 5 assists.{{cite web|title=Cibona - Partizan NIS Full Statistics|url=http://www.abaliga.com/game/131/Cibona-Partizan_NIS#statistic_FullStatistic|work=abaliga.com|accessdate=24 April 2014}} Over 23 games in the Euroleague, he averaged 14.8 points, 3.7 rebounds and assists per game, all career-high.{{cite web|title=NBA scouts think Bogdan Bogdanovic is tough enough to play in the NBA|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/serbia/116508/nba-scouts-think-bogdan-bogdanovic-is-tough-enough-to-play-in-the-nba.html|work=Sportando|publisher=NBA.com|accessdate=17 April 2014}} In April 2014, alongside with his teammate [[Joffrey Lauvergne]], he was selected for the ideal team of the [[2013–14 ABA League|ABA League]].{{cite web|title=The ideal five of the 2013/14 season selected|url=http://www.abaliga.com/a7487/News/The_ideal_five_of_the_2013/14_season_selected.html|work=abaliga.com|accessdate=21 April 2014}}{{cite web|title=ABA: ’Večiti’ i Šarić u timu lige|url=http://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2014&mm=04&dd=21&nav_id=838871|work=b92.net|accessdate=21 April 2014}}{{sr icon}} In May 2014, he has been voted the [[2013-14 Euroleague|Euroleague]] [[Euroleague Rising Star|Rising Star]] of the season by the head coaches of 24 Euroleague teams.{{cite web|title=Euroleague coaches choose Partizan's Bogdanovic for Rising Star Trophy|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/136784|work=Euroleague.net|accessdate=7 May 2014}} Partizan finished season by winning its 13th consecutive title, defeating once again arch rivals [[KK Crvena zvezda|Red Star Belgrade]] by 3-1 in the final series.{{cite web|title=Ništa novo, Partizan je šampion!|url=http://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2014&mm=06&dd=21&nav_id=865626|website=b92.net|accessdate=21 June 2014|language=Serbian}} Bogdanović exploded in the series, averaging 30.8 points, 4.8 rebounds and 4.2 assists per game. For such performance he was named Finals MVP.{{cite web|title=Bogdan: "Titula za devojčicu sa VMA!"|url=http://www.sportske.net/vest/kosarka/bogdan-titula-za-devojcicu-sa-vma-183979.html|website=sportske.net|accessdate=21 June 2014|language=Serbian}} ==Serbian national team== Bogdanović played for [[Serbia men's national under-18 and under-19 basketball team|Serbian national team]] at the [[2011 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]] in [[Latvia]] and won a silver medal.{{cite web|title=World Championship U19, Valanciunas leads Lithuania to gold medal|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/national-teams/national-teams/87234/world-championship-u19-valanciunas-leads-lithuania-to-gold-medal.html|work=Sportando|publisher=latvia2011.fiba.com|accessdate=14
